baseline.method: Original KwiatLab MLE on 36 measured corrected counts

metric_definitions.density_distance: Frobenius norm of complex density difference; no phase, scale or basis alignment
metric_definitions.intensity_relative_error: absolute scalar difference divided by reference intensity
metric_definitions.observation_rmse: RMS(Born predicted corrected counts minus observed corrected counts)/submitted intensity
metric_definitions.physicality: maximum of trace error, Hermitian Frobenius error, negative minimum eigenvalue

threshold_provenance: Independent native reruns with mixed initial states differed by <=1.48914e-6 Frobenius and2.54322e-9 scale-relative; float32 representation errors1.06071e-8 and2.73638e-8. Tightened from preimplementation conservative bounds before release.
